author: ITzKayleigh
body: Okay well I got banned on May 2nd 2015 for advertising my own server. I no longer have that server and I love playing on Avicus it's took me so long to do this Appel because the person who banned me banned my ip as well so I couldn't authenticate my account but I got my friend to do it for me. I got banned by a person I forget who but he then came on my server and said he would unban me if I made him op. Me trusting everyone I did and he totally destroyed my whole server. I play walls on Avicus and I can't find a server I would rather play so if I can please be unbanned that would be great. Thanks Kayleigh

title: Banned.

replies.author: Pelpelajax
replies.body:
Hello,

You still advertised, regardless of the fact that your server doesn't exist anymore. You will not be appealed. Don't be afraid to try and appeal this ban in the future.

Regards,
Pelpelajax,
Avicus Network Senior Moderator.
